defect: The latch is transparent when clk_i is HIGH, including immediately after the first-stage rising edge. It does not supply the closed low-phase settling interval assumed by the second reader and forwards first-stage uncertainty into the active consumer reset.

mutation.description: The second stage is a latch transparent while the first stage samples reset release. It immediately forwards first-stage uncertainty to the consumer reset with no intervening closed settling interval.

labels.note: A first-stage flop followed by a low-phase latch gives only technology-dependent settling time; safety needs a characterized latch synchronizer/MTBF contract.
